title: घुम्ने मेचमाथि अन्धो मान्छे कवितामा व्याकरणिक संसक्ति {Grammatical Syntax in the Poem the 'Ghumne Mech  mathi Andho Manchhe'}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कवि भूपि शेरचनद्वारा लिखित घुम्ने मेचमाथि अन्धो मान्छे कविताको व्याकरणिक संसक्ति व्यवस्थाको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनको पूर्णताका लागि संकथन अध्ययनभित्रको संसक्ति व्यवस्था अन्तगर्तको व्याकरणिक संसक्तिलाई सैद्धान्तिक पर्याधारका रूपमा प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनसँग सम्बन्धित मूल समस्या र शोध्य प्रश्न निरुपणका लागि गुणात्मक तथा सङ्ख्यात्मक अनुसन्धान पद्धति तथा विश्लेषणात्मक विधिको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनमा तत्कालीन नेपाली सामन्तवादी बन्द समाजमा समयको गतिशीलतासँगै गतिशील हुन नसकेका आम नेपाली जनताको प्रतिनिधिमूलक चरित्र समाख्याता (म) पात्रको अस्तित्वहीन, निरीह, निस्तेज, निराशावादी, प्राणहीन, चिन्तनलाई कवितामा प्रयुक्त पदपदावलीको उचित संयोजनले कसरी सुसंबद्ध र सङ्गठित पाठको निर्माण भएको छ भन्ने पक्षलाई व्याकरणिक संसक्तिका निर्मितिका आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । व्यङ्ग्यात्मक पुट भरिएको यस कवितामा तत्कालीन समयमा जनता कतिसम्म निरीह भएर बाँच्न विवश थिए भन्ने सन्दर्भलाई पाठभित्र आएका निदर्शन, प्रतिस्थापन, लोप, सावर्न ामीकरण र सम्योजन जस्ताव्याकरणिक संसक्तिले कसरी पाठको अर्थलाई एकान्वित र सुसंबद्ध तुल्याई सङ्गठित पाठ निर्माण गरेका छन् भन्ने सन्दर्भको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । शीर्षकबाटै स्थूल संयुक्ति अभिव्यक्त गरिएको यस कवितामा अन्तर्निहित भाव, परिवेश र सन्दर्भलाई व्याकरणिक संसतिmले कसरी संसक्त तुल्याई कविताको आदिदेखि अन्त्यसम्मको भावगत एकत्वलाई प्रवाह गरेका छन् भन्ने कुरा अध्ययन गरिएको छ र कवितालाई भावको श्रृङ्खलाबद्ध सूचना प्रवाहको संसक्तताबाट व्यवस्थित, सङ्गठित, सुसम्बद्ध पाठका रुपमा रहेको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This article studies the system of grammatical coherence in the poem Ghumne Mech Mathi Andho Manchhe, written by the poet Bhupi Sherchan. For the completeness of this study, grammatical coherence within the coherence system inside narrative study has been used as a theoretical base. To resolve the main problem and the research questions connected with this study, qualitative and quantitative research methods along with an analytical method have been used. This study analyzes, on the basis of the construction of grammatical coherence, the question of how the proper combination of the diction used in the poem has built a coherent and organized text out of the non-existence, helplessness, dullness, pessimism, lifelessness and reflection of the narrator ('I') character, who is the representative character of the ordinary Nepali people unable to remain dynamic along with the dynamism of time in the feudal, closed Nepali society of that time. This poem, filled with satirical thrust, is analyzed with respect to how the grammatical coherence of devices such as exemplification, substitution, deletion, assimilation and combination that appear within the text has made the meaning of the text unified and coherent and built an organized text, in relation to the context of how helpless the people were forced to live in the contemporary period. In this poem, in which an obvious conjunction is expressed from the title itself, a study has been made of how grammatical coherence has made the inherent emotion, atmosphere and context coherent and carried the emotional unity of the poem from beginning to end, and the conclusion is drawn that the poem remains a systematic, organized, coherent text through the coherence of the chain-like flow of emotional information.

informal_english: This article digs into the system of grammatical coherence in Bhupi Sherchan's poem Ghumne Mech Mathi Andho Manchhe. To make the study complete, it leans on grammatical coherence as a theoretical base, taking it from the coherence system inside narrative study. To get at the main problem and the research questions tied to this study, it uses qualitative and quantitative research methods plus an analytical approach. The study analyzes how the right mix of the word choices in the poem has built a coherent, organized text out of the non-existence, helplessness, dullness, pessimism, lifelessness and reflection of the narrator ('I') character, the stand-in for ordinary Nepali people who could not keep up with the changing times in the feudal, closed Nepali society of that era, and it does that on the basis of how grammatical coherence gets built. The poem is loaded with a satirical bite, and the study looks at how the grammatical coherence of devices like exemplification, substitution, deletion, assimilation and combination that show up in the text has pulled the meaning together and made it hang together to form an organized text, with an eye on how helpless people were forced to live back then. The title itself throws out an obvious conjunction, and the study looks at how grammatical coherence has tied together the inherent feeling, setting and context and kept the emotional unity of the poem flowing from start to finish; the takeaway is that the poem works as a systematic, organized, coherent text thanks to the coherence of that chain-like flow of emotional information.
